diagnosis: LOW_YIELD was amplified by an over-broad preclaim transport classification. Durable batch receipts showed workers closing at 0-1 productive units under CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED, but only one receipt explicitly proved an authorization/safety denial. The existing protocol already distinguished CREATE_EXISTS and BRANCH_HEAD_MOVED, yet an unclassified bounded write failure could still be collapsed into the same hard-stop label, hiding whether the failure was an explicit denial or transport ambiguity.
intervention: Kept explicit authorization/safety denials fail-closed and non-retryable, while adding CLAIM_TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS for failures that prove neither denial, target-path existence nor branch-head movement. Ambiguous pre-authority failures may use at most one diversion to an already-loaded untried compatible candidate with a different claim path and no extra preclaim read. A second ambiguous failure stops. Added EFF031, a dedicated regression, CI wiring, ratchet checks, canonical wc v3.26 wording, FAST allocation contract, and the public /wc pointer. No safety-control bypass or same denied-path retry is permitted.
